title: Fowl play Thanksgiving escape
author: Mrbuttshaman
selftext: I made this for my niece for thanksgiving.  I started with a prompt about a turkey breaking out of a house at thanksgiving and had it modeled after untitled goose games structure since she loved that game. I asked for crazy goofy physics interactions to make it more fun.  First generation was really boring, and far too short, so I moved it to a mansion with a hedge maze, a secret mad scientist lab, and bowling area.  This was fun and fit what I was going for. At thanksgiving today my niece played it and got hooked for about a half hour playing it over and over.  Then I told her we could expand it if she wanted.  She didn't have any ideas so I asked her to help me brainstorm.  I said how would the turkey get revenge.  She said it would go to space, that inspired the area 51 level, then I asked about where it would go.  I said the moon, she said Venus and then it would befriend aliens.  I said how would it get revenge with the aliens?  She said it would fire a meteor at earth, I told her that wouldn't work for a stage, I said how about it shrinks the earth and then rampages through the earth. She said she loved that idea and anyway here we are.  The new stages were still too boring on their first generation so I had to do a few prompts to flesh them out but they really weren't intense at all.  I only spent like an hour and a half total on this one, not counting play testing with my niece.
